item.title: Harbor daily council report
item.description: Harbor investigation coverage for the timeline acceptance flow. Aldermen debated zoning amendments, ferry subsidies and a proposed promenade before postponing the budget vote until residents testify.

item.title: Harbor daily dredging report
item.description: Harbor investigation coverage for the timeline acceptance flow. Engineers measured silt depth along the navigation channel, warning that sediment disposal could smother nearby oyster beds.

item.title: Harbor daily closing report
item.description: Harbor investigation coverage for the timeline acceptance flow. Magistrates adjourned the final hearing after lawyers summarised evidence, leaving the verdict and any compensation orders pending.
